meta.title: Network Failure & Reconnection Tests
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create stress tests that simulate network failures and measure reconnection behavior to validate system resilience to network issues.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Network failure simulation works (disconnect detected within 60 seconds)
Reconnection behavior validated (exponential backoff, succeeds within 30 seconds)
Circuit breaker behavior validated (trips after threshold, safe state, cooldown recovery)
Stress test report generated with metrics (disconnections, avg/max reconnection time, circuit breaker trips)
Multiple scenarios tested: single disconnect, rapid disconnects, disconnect during active order

key-tasks.task: Implement scenario tests (single, rapid, during order, with positions)

architecture-context.constraint: Orders queued during brief disconnections less than 30 seconds (NFR9)
